title: Persona vocabulary check against known library tags

sections.what: Check id-list entries (`fears`, `interests`, `traits`) against the library's authoritative tag registry (`data/library/tags/`). Surface unmatched tags as "free tags" while offering autocompletion against canonical library tags.
sections.why: A typo in a tag slug (e.g. `arachnid` instead of `spider` or `spiders`) prevents `engine.fear` and perception matching from triggering against authored hazards, making authored traits silently inert.
sections.how:
- Expose a tag catalog endpoint or reuse `GET /api/library/tags`.
- In `static/js/inspector/mind-view.ts`, visually distinguish known tags (solid border) from unrecognized custom tags (dashed border).
- Provide autocomplete suggestions in tag input fields.

acceptance.text: Persona tag inputs provide autocomplete against known library tag slugs.
Tags not found in the library catalog render with distinct styling in the UI.
Unknown tags remain valid without blocking custom authoring.
